rule: An exported binding whose declared type uses infer stays identical when another export of its file moves behind a re-export, because its own declared type is compared in a form without infer.
pattern: a native adapter header moves a function declaration behind a platform re-export while an unchanged deferred generic const stays in the entry file

before.index.d.ts:
export declare const f: <C>(c: C) => C extends (infer I)[] ? I : never;
export declare function g(x: number): number;

after.index.d.ts:
export declare const f: <C>(c: C) => C extends (infer I)[] ? I : never;
export { g } from "./helper.js";
after.helper.d.ts: export declare function g(x: number): number;
